description: Header file defining the MojoCdmHelper class, which connects the Content Decryption Module (CDM) to auxiliary services such as FileIO, output protection, and platform verification within the media namespace. It declares class methods, private members, and dependencies related to media CDM helper functionalities.

classes.name: MojoCdmHelper
classes.description: A helper class that manages connections between the CDM and auxiliary services, providing methods for protection, storage, and file I/O operations.

methods.name: MojoCdmHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with a frame interface factory.

methods.name: SetFileReadCB
methods.description: Sets the callback for file read operations.

methods.name: CreateCdmFileIO
methods.description: Creates a CDM file I/O object.

methods.name: GetCdmOrigin
methods.description: Returns the origin associated with the CDM.

methods.name: CreateCdmBuffer
methods.description: Creates a buffer for the CDM with specified capacity.

methods.name: CreateCdmVideoFrame
methods.description: Creates a video frame for the CDM.

methods.name: QueryStatus
methods.description: Queries the current status of the CDM.

methods.name: EnableProtection
methods.description: Enables output protection with a specified mask.

methods.name: ChallengePlatform
methods.description: Performs a platform challenge with given service ID and challenge string.

methods.name: GetStorageId
methods.description: Retrieves the storage ID with specified version.

methods.name: GetMediaFoundationCdmData
methods.description: Retrieves Media Foundation CDM data (Windows only).

methods.name: SetCdmClientToken
methods.description: Sets the CDM client token (Windows only).

methods.name: CloseCdmFileIO
methods.description: Closes a CDM file I/O object.

methods.name: ReportFileReadSize
methods.description: Reports the size of a file read operation.
